[English] AI Cinema Studio is a production-planning skill for AI films, animated drama, live-action style shorts, MVs, ads, and multi-shot video prompts. It turns a concept, script, reference, or rough brief into a reliable film-production package: creative brief, character and scene continuity cards, screenplay beats, shot list, tool-adapted prompts, transition plan, editing rhythm, sound-design sheet, and Markdown/CSV/JSON deliverables. A four-layer character system (genre presets, aesthetic library, performance system, six-point consistency check) defeats the generic-AI-face problem. Reference-anchor extraction and genre visual anchors solve the two most common complaints: prompts that are too thin and outputs that miss the requested genre. The narrative-to-shot system gives every shot and transition a story reason. Use this skill for AI cinema planning, storyboard breakdown, shot prompts, video script polishing, transition design, editing plans, sound design, character consistency, scene-adapted dialogue, motion-shot prompts (chases / one-takes), image composition (character sheets / first frames), storyboard-driven three-step pipeline, or end-to-end AI video pre-production. It is not for a single casual image or one-shot image-to-video clip. 建库三步：

与RAG不同，更精准，快速地获取完整的知识，而不是零散的需要拼凑的知识。
